data.title: Plan infra — state.js POST · reckon-sync · reckon-create
data.phase: shipped — reckon server + reckon-sync + reckon-create fully landed 2026-05-26
data.summary: Infrastructure work that bootstrapped the reckon planning system. The reckon repo is now the canonical source for the SPA, shared CSS/JSX, and the reckon server (formerly docs-server). reckon-sync replaced /plan-style refresh + /plan-init as the single onboarding skill. reckon-create replaced ad-hoc scaffolding. The Persist/state.js POST contract with 412 conflict detection shipped and is live.

sections.body: All infrastructure pieces landed. The reckon server (uv run reckon serve) is the HTTP backend on :8765. The reckon MCP transport (uv run reckon mcp) exposes the same state write operations to Claude Code and other MCP clients. The canonical SPA template lives under reckon/docs/. reckon-sync copies docs/_shared/ and docs/ui/ into consumer project docs/ directories and registers them in mounts.json. Previously, the canonical source was dotfiles/claude/skills/html-docs/templates/ — that reference is now stale; the reckon repo is authoritative.

The Persist pattern in ui.jsx and state.js both POST to the reckon server in local mode. Version field + 412 on mismatch is the conflict-detection strategy (decision: conflict-detection). localStorage serves as a read-cache when the server is unreachable. The 412 contract is enforced by serve.py and was verified end-to-end on 2026-05-21 (commit 4874ff8 in dotfiles; now maintained in reckon/reckon/serve.py).

The reckon-sync skill is the canonical onboarding and refresh tool. It symlinks reckon skills into ~/.claude/skills/, copies docs/_shared/ (foundation.css, dashboard.css, state.js) and docs/ui/ (v7-shell.jsx, state-loader.js) into the consumer project, sets up docs/state/<project>/, symlinks ~/docs-server/state/<project>, registers in mounts.json, and drops .nojekyll. Idempotent. The /plan-style and /plan-init skills in dotfiles are superseded; reckon-sync covers their full scope plus React SPA wiring.

New plans are scaffolded with reckon-create: creates docs/<slug>.html from template, seeds docs/state/<project>/<slug>.json with initial state, and registers the plan in the relevant index JSON. Repo-agnostic. Previously this required manual copying from dotfiles templates; reckon-create codifies the full flow as a skill with /reckon-create <slug> as the trigger.

followups.title: Implement state.js POST + extend plan-style + write plan-init
followups.body: Three connected pieces: (1) state.js gets the same fetch/merge/POST that Persist in ui.jsx has, with localStorage fallback. (2) /plan-style refresh learns to sync system pages, not just CSS. (3) /plan-init scaffolds a new repo's docs/. All three land in dotfiles main.
